title: Exponentiation
statementMd:
You are given integers $*a*$, $*b*$ and $*c*$. Calculate $*a*^{*b*}$ modulo $*c*$.

## Input

Input data contains numbers $*a*$, $*b*$ and $*c*$, one number per line. Each number is an integer between $1$ and $100$, inclusive.

## Output

Output $*a*^{*b*}$ mod $*c*$.
